jobs.title: Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

  • Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

  • Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

  • Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

  • Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

  • Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

  • Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

Nice to have:

  • A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

  • Experience inside a paritariste institution

  • Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

  • Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

  • International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

  • Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

  • Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

  • Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

  • Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

  • Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

  • VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

  • Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

  • Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

  • Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

  • Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

  • Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

  • Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

  • Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

  • Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a video team in place, and a team of interns to grow. The brand is yours to build and yours to run.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
jobs.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.


What You Will Do
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.
  • Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout.
  • Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.
  • Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap.
  • Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.
  • Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction.

    • Where You'll Be
  • You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments.
  • You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.
  • You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.
  • You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions.
  • You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
  • You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost.
  • You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes.
  • You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence.

    • Where You Will Be
  • This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Mehrjährige, tiefgehende Accounting-Erfahrung – sowohl hands-on im laufenden Geschäft als auch im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung robuster Prozesse.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Account Manager do at WPP Production? 

As part of the Client Services Department, you play a central role in the business and are pivotal to the smooth running of your account. You will be required to have a thorough understanding of all areas of the business and be responsible for managing projects from brief to final delivery on time and budget. You will be client focused and require good communication, organisation and time management skills to manage both your clients and internal departments, while always focusing on quality, process and profitability. 

  

What does a Senior Account Manager do at WPP Production, on the TJX account? 

You will be working within the client's Activation Account team, implanted onsite working on behalf of the client. You will attend TJX office in Watford two/three times a week and occasionally work from the WPP Production office in London. You will deliver projects, working with TJX's onsite in-house creative team. You will be responsible for managing projects from briefing to final delivery, ensuring that TJX stakeholders, clients and agencies, adhere to set timings to ensure a timely delivery of all projects. You will be working on a range of Digital Media projects, such as Web, Email and Paid Media 

  

Client management responsibilities:  

  • Immerse yourself in the client's brand and offering 
  • Prepare client proposals 
  • Present and deliver creative work appropriately – take ownership of your work and ensure best in class delivery of work to a high standard 
  • Provide weekly status reports, accompanied by a meeting or call as per client needs

  • Set and manage client expectations deliverables and timeframes

  • Build strong day to day relationships with all clients and agency stakeholders – communication is key 
  • Identify training requirements and opportunities for clients to ensure their adherence to processes and improve workflow 

  

Project Management responsibilities:  

  • Co-ordinate between all relevant parties, this might be internally within the client TJX, internally within WPP Production or with other agencies and 3rdparty partners of TJX.  
  • Consistently deliver against all contractual obligations include SLAs and KPIs

Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. It strengthens our independence, sharpens our long-term focus and ensures success is shared. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

jobs.description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.

  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.

  • Good communication skills in English.

Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

  • Coacher les autres membres de l’équipe et se partager les bonnes pratiques. 

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! 

  • Tu vis dans le Sud de la France, autour de Toulouse, Montpellier, Marseille, Toulon ou Nice ;

  •  Tu as +6 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseigne ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ; tu sais gérer des deals complexes ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu aimes guider et mentorer des collaborateurs juniors pour les accompagner et développer leur autonomie au quotidien ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

Was uns fehlt, ist schlicht jemand, der konsequent dranbleibt: ungefähr 1–2 Kampagnen pro Woche, selbst gute Themen und Ideen entwickelt, die Newsletter umsetzt und nebenbei unsere bestehenden Flows und Automationen Stück für Stück verbessert.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst und verschickst ca. 1–2 Newsletter pro Woche
  • Du überlegst dir selbst passende Themen, Hooks, Produkte und Angebote
  • Du baust die Kampagnen eigenständig in Brevo
  • Du wählst sinnvolle Zielgruppen und Segmente
  • Du schaust dir nach dem Versand die Ergebnisse an
  • Du testest Betreffzeilen, Inhalte, Angebote und Versandzeitpunkte
  • Du arbeitest dich regelmäßig durch unsere bestehenden Automationen und Flows
  • Du findest kleinere Optimierungsmöglichkeiten und setzt sie um
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, statt darauf zu warten, dass wir dir jede Kampagne vorgeben

Qualifikation

Wichtiger als fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung ist uns, dass du die Basics bereits praktisch beherrschst. Du darfst ausdrücklich junior sein. Erfahrung mit Shopify/Email-CRMs & Workflows sind von Vorteil

  • mit Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp oder einem vergleichbaren Tool gearbeitet haben
  • einen Newsletter selbst gebaut und verschickt haben
  • mit Segmenten gearbeitet haben
  • Kampagnen ausgewertet haben
  • grundlegende E-Commerce-Kennzahlen wie Klickrate, Conversion und Umsatz verstanden haben
  • idealerweise schon einmal einen Welcome-, Abandoned-Cart-, Post-Purchase- oder ähnlichen Flow gesehen, gebaut oder optimiert haben

Nicht passend ist die Stelle, wenn E-Mail-Marketing für dich komplett neu ist und wir dir das Tool von Grund auf erklären müssten.

Benefits

  • Kostenfreier Zugang zu Festivals & Events in ganz Europa – weil wir gute Erlebnisse feiern.
  • 100% Remote & flexible Zeiten – arbeite, wann und wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Weiterbildung & Wunschliteratur – wir investieren aktiv in dein Wissen & Wachstum.
  • Tiefe Einblicke in einen seit 10 Jahren profitablen D2C-Shop – lerne, wie ein echter Bootstrapped-Selbstläufer funktioniert.
  • Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 – du gestaltest deinen Bereich frei und führst Projekte eigenständig.
  • Raum für mutige Ideen – alles, was skalieren kann, darf getestet werden.

Schick uns bitte keine klassische Bewerbung. Prahle. Erzähl uns gerne wer du bist. Aber vor allem zeig uns was du kannst. Noten interessieren uns weniger als deine Fähigkeiten. Zeig uns deine Erfolge. Liste auf, was du geschafft hast. Das zählt so viel mehr.

SO BEWIRBST DU DICH

  1. Sag uns im Anschreiben, mit welchen E-Mail-Marketing-Tools du schon gearbeitet hast – z. B. Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp oder ähnliche – und was du dort konkret gemacht hast.
  2. Zeig uns, wenn möglich, 1–2 Beispiele von Kampagnen, Newslettern oder Flows, an denen du gearbeitet hast. Screenshots, Links oder anonymisierte Ergebnisse sind vollkommen okay.

**Wir glauben nicht an nine to five oder ständiges Schultertippen. Du wirst die Autonomie haben, dich selbst zu managen. Wir glauben, dass du deine Tage so strukturieren solltest, dass du dich am besten fühlst, wenn du tatsächlich arbeiten möchtest. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir ein gewisses Maß an Selbständigkeit, Antrieb und Vertrauen.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.

Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.
  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)
  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.
  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).
  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.
  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.
  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.

Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.
  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.
  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.
  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.
  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.

Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.
  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern
  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.
  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.
  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Talent Partner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

As

Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.

Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)

Contract type: Full-time, permanent

Start: October/November
Location: Berlin

#The role

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.

The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.

You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

#What you will do

  • Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications. You run the culture screen as the first interview of every process and protect the hiring bar, founders included.
  • Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp.
  • Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration, retention bets on key people.
  • Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking and your time keeps moving toward talent and culture.

#What we offer

  • People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders
  • VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful
  • Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds
  • Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design
  • Team & culture: regular offsites
  • Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies

Requirements

#What you bring

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience from high-paced environments: a high-growth startup or scaleup, the talent team of a VC or PE firm, or a top search firm, including senior and engineering searches you sourced and closed yourself. Years matter less than evidence: show us numbers (pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, quality of hire after 12 months).
  • AI as your default way of working, not a tool you tried. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built: sourcing and market mapping, structured screening support, scorecard synthesis, drafting at scale. In the interview, you will show us one, live.
  • Automation literacy: You have connected tools via APIs or no-code (Apps Script, Zapier/Make/n8n or similar) to kill manual work. You read API docs without flinching. You do not need to be an engineer; you need to think like one about repetitive tasks.
  • Evidence-based assessment: You run structured interviews and can defend a hire or no-hire with observations, not impressions. A track record of calls that aged well: hires that outperformed, hard cases you named early.
  • German employment law working knowledge: contracts, terminations, fixed terms, works-council-free environments. Enough to know when you need a lawyer, and when you do not.
  • Data fluency: strong Sheets/Excel, comfortable owning funnel and retention metrics end to end; SQL basics a plus.
  • German (C1+) and English fluent. Our contracts are German, our company language is English.
  • First-principles thinker who writes things down. Default output

The process

Exactly the one you will later run: culture screen, skill assessment with a live case (bring your AI workflows), founder final.

We evaluate based on ability and potential, independent of age, gender identity, origin, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.

jobs.description:
Wir bauen Anwendungen, die im Betrieb bestehen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der ein Feature von der Datenbank bis ins Interface fertig macht und nicht auf halber Strecke stehen bleibt.

Worum es bei uns geht

Unsere Projekte laufen über Jahre, nicht über einzelne Sprints. Saubere Architektur und klare Datenmodelle sind bei uns kein Nachgedanke, sondern die Voraussetzung dafür, dass Produkte wachsen können. KI gehört dabei zum Produkt und zum Arbeitsalltag, nicht in ein Sonderprojekt am Rand.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest in einem unserer Produktteams und verantwortest Features über den kompletten Stack.

  • Backend mit Laravel und PHP 8.2+
  • Frontend mit Vue.js
  • Anbindung von APIs und Drittsystemen
  • Umsetzung von KI-Funktionen in Kundenprodukten, zum Beispiel RAG-Workflows oder Assistenzfunktionen

Qualifikation

Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Webentwicklung mit Laravel und Vue.js. Wichtig ist uns, dass du den Unterschied kennst zwischen einem Feature, das funktioniert, und einem, das in zwölf Monaten noch wartbar ist.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit PHP 8+, JavaScript, TypeScript, Git, Code Reviews und Deployments

  • Erfahrungen mit anderen Software-Stacks wie CMS oder anderen Frameworks und Programmiersprachen

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Projekte mit echten Nutzerzahlen statt Prototypen für die Schublade
  • Aktueller Stack, auch bei den KI-Tools
  • Zeit für Weiterbildung und fachlichen Austausch im Team
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise (remote, hybrid oder vor Ort)

Wenn du Produkte bauen willst, die länger halten als ein Projektzyklus, freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Eimear (our Director of Finance) is heading off on maternity leave, and we're looking for an interim Finance Director to hold the seat for ~8 months (October to May).

This isn't a caretaker role, and it isn't a pure people-leadership role either. You're a player-coach in FP&A, meaning you’ll:

  • personally run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end,

  • partner with other execs as a peer to shape strategy, and

  • coach a Financial Controller and an Analyst on everything else.

Success means:

  1. Own and run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end: budget, monthly reforecast, board packs, monthly exec business reviews.

  2. Partner with the CEO and exec team as a peer, shaping board and investor reporting and influencing strategic finance decisions as they arise.

  3. Lead the finance team, with an active coaching load on month-end.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

  • You've worked in a B2B SaaS company for a significant part of the last 2 years.

  • You've personally run a full FP&A cycle end-to-end (budget, reforecasts, board reporting), not just contributed to one someone else owned.

  • You're accounting-literate and can support and challenge a controller, even if you're not the one closing the books.

  • You've been the finance owner in a diligence process. That means you've built the data room and held numbers up under external scrutiny.

  • You've partnered directly with execs and a board; not just reporting numbers to them, but shaping and influencing their decisions.

  • You've led a small finance team.

  • You've been hands-on and energised by rolling up your sleeves.

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • You need time and coaching to grow into the role; we need someone who can land running, our CEO won’t have the time to train you.

  • You'd rather direct than build.

  • High-stakes corporate moments (transactions, diligence, board scrutiny) are unfamiliar territory.

  • You've never partnered with execs or led a team.

  • Your FP&A experience is "supporting" rather than owning.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

jobs.title: Social Media & Content Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 20h, 100% Remote
jobs.description:
Du hast Bock auf Social Media Marketing und willst organische Reichweite aufbauen, die direkt Einfluss auf die Performance hat? Du willst Kanäle nicht verwalten, sondern selbst bespielen, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Reel? Dann lies weiter.

Damit wir uns nicht missverstehen: Wir suchen keine reine Redaktionsplan-Verwaltung, die Content einplant, den jemand anderes produziert. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kanäle in die Hand nimmt. Du suchst die Creatorinnen, du schreibst, was gedreht werden soll, du schneidest, du postest, du antwortest und du sprichst unsere Ads ein. Und du zeigst dich selbst: in unseren Stories, vor der Kamera, mit deiner Stimme. Wenn du lieber im Hintergrund bleibst, passt es nicht. Bei uns liegt Organic komplett bei dir.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content.

  • Du bespielst Instagram und TikTok mit Reels, Stories und Posts, sodass wir präsent sind.
  • Du produzierst und schneidest selbst: aus Creator-Material und eigenen Aufnahmen baust du Videos, die unser Produkt richtig in Szene setzen.
  • Du betreust unsere Community auf Instagram und Facebook, beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten und erkennst dabei, welche Fragen immer wieder kommen. Aus genau diesen Fragen machst du dann Stories und Reels, die sie beantworten.
  • Du findest neue UGC-Creatorinnen, die zu uns passen, verhandelst Barter-Deals und arbeitest mit Plattformen wie Trybe, etc.
  • Du schreibst die Shootinglisten für unsere Creatorinnen, sammelst das Material ein und sortierst es so, dass wir damit arbeiten können.
  • Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera: eine Story aus deinem Alltag, ein spontanes Video aus dem Lager, eine Ansage an die Community. Und du wirkst bei unseren Ad-Creatives mit, wenn wir dich brauchen.
  • Du sprichst die Voice-Over für unsere Ads ein.
  • Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus.
  • Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing oder in der Content-Produktion, idealerweise für eine Brand oder im E-Commerce.
  • Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool.
  • Du hast eine angenehme, natürliche Sprechstimme und Lust darauf, regelmäßig Voice-Over einzusprechen.
  • Du bist extrovertiert und stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera. In die Kamera sprechen, ins Mikro sprechen, dich in unseren Stories mit deinem Gesicht zeigen, ist für dich kein Problem.
  • Du erkennst Formate und Trends früh und probierst sie aus, statt darauf zu warten, dass jemand sie freigibt.
  • Du triffst im Community Management den richtigen Ton, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn eine Kundin genervt schreibt.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, weil alles was du schreibst direkt bei unseren Kundinnen landet.
  • Du organisierst dich im Remote-Setup selbst und ziehst Themen durch, auch wenn niemand zuschaut.
  • Nice-to-have: erste Berührung mit Affiliate- oder Deal-Plattformen, Erfahrung im Verhandeln mit Creatorinnen und deren Managements.

Benefits

  • 100% Remote, du arbeitest, wo du willst.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. Wir bewerten dich nach Leistung, nicht nach Anwesenheit.
  • Arzttermine, Workation und Ähnliches sind bei uns unkompliziert möglich, kurze Absprache reicht.
  • Flache Hierarchien.
  • Performance-Bonus für echte Ergebnisse.
  • Netzwerk: Sivara ist eng vernetzt mit den führenden D2C-Brands Deutschlands und tauscht sich täglich mit anderen E-Commerce-Brands im 8- bis 9-stelligen Bereich aus. Du bekommst Einblicke und Kontakte, die du dir sonst über Jahre aufbauen müsstest.

Bis hier durch? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick mir gerne ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du. Was hast du bisher gemacht, welche Kanäle oder Accounts hast du selbst bespielt, was war dein bestes Video und warum hat es funktioniert, ab wann hättest du Lust, etc.

Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "ich bin teamfähig und belastbar", sondern lieber kurz und knapp warum du perfekt geeignet bist und ggf. ein Portfolio-Link zu deiner bisherigen Arbeit.

Ich freu mich von dir zu hören!

Beste Grüße
Kacper

What You’ll Be Doing

jobs.title: PR & Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
Title - PR & Marketing Executive

Location - Remote first but available for in person collaboration in Edinburgh or London

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready AI solutions that help financial services firms transform how they operate, manage risk and deliver better outcomes for their customers.

We’re looking for a PR & Marketing Executive to help build Aveni’s profile across the UK financial services market and support the delivery of our PR, communications and wider marketing activity.

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who knows what makes a good story, enjoys building relationships with journalists and wants to develop their career at the intersection of AI, fintech and financial services.

 

The role

 

Working closely with the Head of PR & Communications, you’ll help tell Aveni’s story to the market, building relationships with journalists and industry influencers, identifying opportunities for Aveni to contribute to the conversation and securing relevant media coverage.

You’ll support the development of proactive PR campaigns, commentary and thought leadership around Aveni’s business priorities, product developments, customer successes and the wider issues shaping financial services.

The role goes beyond traditional media relations. You’ll also contribute to customer stories, executive and internal communications, events, awards, speaker opportunities, analyst relations and wider marketing campaigns.

You’ll work across Aveni, collaborating with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior leadership to make sure our communications are timely, consistent and aligned with our brand and market positioning.

 

What you’ll be doing

 

  • You’ll build and maintain relationships with journalists across UK business, financial services, fintech, compliance, risk and technology media, proactively pitching stories, commentary, interviews and contributed content.

  • You’ll support the development and delivery of PR campaigns around Aveni’s business priorities, product launches, research, customer stories and relevant market developments.

  • You’ll help run Aveni’s day-to-day press office, responding to journalist enquiries, identifying commentary opportunities, coordinating interviews and preparing briefing materials.

  • You’ll maintain our communications and editorial calendar across PR, thought leadership, research, webinars, awards, speaking opportunities and company announcements.

  • You’ll work with Sales and Customer Success to identify and develop compelling customer stories, case studies, testimonials and joint communications.

  • You’ll support internal communications, helping colleagues stay informed about company news, customer wins, product developments, events and media coverage.

  • You’ll work with Aveni’s senior leaders and subject matter experts to build their external profiles through LinkedIn content, commentary, talking points and other communications.

  • You’ll support our thought leadership programme, helping develop webinars, research reports, whitepapers and other content around the issues that matter to our market.

  • You’ll identify and coordinate relevant conference, panel, podcast and webinar speaking opportunities, as well as industry awards.

  • You’ll support our relationships with industry analysts and research organisations and help coordinate analyst briefings and materials.

  • You’ll work with the wider Marketing team to support conferences, roundtables, webinars and customer events.

 

What we’re looking for

 

  • You’ll have solid experience in PR, communications or a closely related role, with experience working in a B2B environment.

  • You’ll have experience dealing directly with journalists and proactively pitching stories and ideas.

  • You’ll be a strong writer and editor, comfortable producing press releases, pitches, commentary and other external communications.

  • You’ll have strong news judgement and be able to identify what makes a compelling story and how to tailor it for different audiences.

  • You’ll be confident communicating with journalists, senior stakeholders and external partners.

  • You’ll be able to take complex or technical subjects and turn them into clear, engaging communications.

  • You’ll be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities at the same time.

  • You’ll understand the role PR and communications play in building brand awareness, reputation and supporting wider commercial objectives.

  • You’ll have a genuine interest in AI, fintech, financial services and the wider media agenda.

  • You’ll be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly and be confident building relationships across the business.

 

Nice to have

 

  • Experience working with UK financial services, fintech, compliance, risk, regulatory or technology media.

  • Experience within a PR agency and/or an in-house B2B communications role.

  • Existing relationships with journalists covering financial services, fintech, compliance, risk or related sectors.

  • Experience supporting events, awards, speaker programmes or analyst relations.

  • Familiarity with PR monitoring and media database platforms.

  • Experience using HubSpot or other marketing automation platforms.

  • An understanding of the UK financial services and regulatory environment, including areas such as Consumer Duty, compliance, conduct risk and AI governance.

 

Why join Aveni?

 

You’ll be joining Aveni at an exciting point in our growth, working at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape how Aveni shows up in the market, working directly with senior leaders, subject matter experts, customers and journalists to tell stories about some of the most important changes happening across financial services.

It’s a broad role with the opportunity to build experience across media relations, thought leadership, executive communications, customer advocacy and wider marketing – while having genuine ownership and visibility across the business.

 

What you’ll love:

 

  • Remote-first across the UK, with regular off-sites and in-person gatherings.

  • Work abroad policy.

  • Co-working spaces available.

  • 34 days’ holiday, including flexible bank holidays, plus your birthday off.

  • Company-wide off-sites.

  • Optional Personal Development Plan.

  • Flexible benefits platform.

  • Life Insurance, Income Protection and Critical Illness cover.

  • Pension with up to 5% matched employer contribution, with the option to increase contributions.

  • Private health and dental care.

  • Enhanced family leave.

 

Join Us in Making a Difference

 

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work.

If you’re passionate about people, technology and the opportunity to help a growing AI business thrive, we’d love to hear from you.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we’d still like to hear from you if you believe you’d be a great fit.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.
